dedupe_keys.name: tokyo disaster prevention map evacuation shelters and evacuation areas list tokyo metropolitan government open data

description: Two lists behind the Tokyo Disaster Prevention Map, published by the Bureau of General Affairs of the Tokyo Metropolitan Government: evacuation shelters, such as schools and gymnasiums, and evacuation areas, such as parks and sports grounds. Each row gives the facility name, municipality code, address, latitude and longitude, and marks for step-free access or first-floor refuge space, slopes, tactile paving and accessible toilets; the areas file also flags which hazards each area serves: flood, landslide and debris flow, storm surge, earthquake, tsunami, large fire, inland flooding and volcanic phenomena. When read, the shelter file held 2,560 rows and the areas file 2,251, covering the Tokyo municipalities including the Ogasawara islands. Format and access: free CSV files with a definition sheet in XLSX, CC BY 4.0, with attribution to the Tokyo open data required. Caveats: the page says the information is in principle as of 1 April 2021 although the catalogue entry was modified in December 2025, and the shelter file uses Shift-JIS encoding. Useful for evacuation and shelter capacity simulation and for exposure and accessibility analysis of shelters; related records are not yet linked.
